address: Fondamenta Madona de l'Orto, 3500, Venice, 30121, Italy
bio: Hidden within the elegant walls of the NH Collection Palazzo dei Dogi, far from the bustling tourist crowds, Da Lorenzo – Al Giardino Segreto is an oasis of taste created by Paulo Airaudo, a multi-starred Spanish chef, who is assisted in the kitchen by the young Salvatore Paladino. Every dish at this restaurant is a refined combination of culinary technique, elegance and local flavours, enhanced by sophisticated Japanese accents. To immerse themselves in his gastronomic vision, guests can choose between two evocative tasting menus: Emozioni and Sensazioni – two experiences that convey the soul of this restaurant with style....
